headline: Office Coordinator
summary: Office coordinator with three years keeping a mining supply company's branch office running. I handle the front office, clerical work and office supplies, maintain the printers and other equipment, and help the purchasing team with canvassing and stock counts.
skills: Office equipment upkeep: printers, copiers, projectors

experience.title: Office Coordinator
experience.employer: Surigao Mining and Industrial Supply Inc.
bullets: Run the branch front office: visitors, deliveries, courier pickups and the phone line.
Keep printers, copiers and the conference projector working, and log each repair with the service provider.
Order and track office and pantry supplies against a monthly budget.
Canvass three suppliers for small purchases and prepare the comparison sheet for the purchasing officer.
Help with quarterly stock counts of fast-moving items in the showroom.

experience.title: Office Clerk
bullets: Prepared vouchers and receipts and photocopied travel documents for clients.
Kept the office tidy and stocked for walk-in customers.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Business Administration, major in Human Resource Management
